summary: An LTP subscription sends the whole quote set; a quote packet becomes an LTP frame with last_price, the previous close and the change; a packet without a close or a trade time leaves them out; the release unsubscribes the emptied quote stream.

notes: No live capture exists here: the lines are built from the field names the web adapter reads (nuvama_adapter.py `_normalize` and `_depth`, nuvama_order_adapter.py `normalize_order_update`) and the web commit's message; values are strings, as the web's `_f` reads them. The relay frames (ready text, requests as text frames) are the desktop's own (brokers/nuvama/tcp_relay.rs); the web glue hands the web the same line off its own socket.

deviations.reason: A packet without `c` leaves the previous close Nuvama last sent in place (market state overlays until cleared), so the frame keeps the close and the change from it; the web's `_normalize` drops them for that packet only.
